messages.subject: TO FIND BORDER DATA FROM CONVEX HULL
parts:
Hi,


I’m trying to find the border coordinates for the convex hull I drawed using utm_x and utm_y coordinates in my Greenland ICESat data(NEEM Data) using R to make a triangulated mesh to fit spatio-temporal model using R-INLA following the Cameletti et al.(2012). I need the border data in csv format like the one Piemonte_borders.csv in  Cameletti et al.(2012). But, was not able to do that.


Please guide me in this regards. I have attached the convex hull figure with code and the coordinate data used to make convex hull.


Regards,

Jiblal Upadhya

Graduate Student

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] TO FIND BORDER DATA FROM CONVEX HULL
parts:
The following worked for me:

par(tck = 0.02, mgp = c(1.7, 0.3, 0))
plot(x1 , y1 , type = "p", pch = 1, col = "magenta", xlim = c(xrange),
ylim = c(yrange))
idx <- chull(x1, y1)
lines(cbind(x1, y1)[c(idx, idx[1]),], lwd=2, col=4)

Elias
